title: The chairs came out pretty quickly. | Quiet Backyard Living
storyTitle: The chairs came out pretty quickly.
description: After the measuring, hauling, digging, and screws, the deck started earning its place.
noteHtml:
And once it was done, it did not take us long at all to drag out a couple of chairs and start enjoying this new addition to peaceful cabin life.

That part might have been the best reward of all.
